weather.blurb: Heat Advisory today. Take the shade and the water bottle with you.

air.blurb: Cleanest air in days. It is the heat that will limit you today, not the air.

lake.blurb: Close to full, and down a touch from last week. Ramps and docks are fine.

pollen.note: Tree 2 · Grass 3 · Weed 3 · Grasses, Ragweed, Elm
pollen.blurb: Grass, ragweed and elm all moving. Take the pill before it takes you.

grid.blurb: Demand peaks near 88,500 megawatts; ERCOT has 120,000 ready and room to spare.

sun.blurb: Sunset at 7:37, so there is just enough evening left for a lap of the lake.
